images.alt: A graph of the last 24 hours of temperatures at Christchuch and Timaru airports, on a dark blue background. A heading reads "Canterbury Temperatures", with a red chilli pepper on the left and a pale blue row of icicles on the right. The graph has an orange line for Christchurch Airport's temperature, and a yellow line for Ashburton Airport. Both temperatures peak at 1pm on Saturday 20 June, then decrease for every hour after that. A box on the right says "As at 11am Sunday 21 June, Ashburton 8.6°C, Christchurch 7.9°C".

post.text:
Yesterday Christchurch and Ashburton airports smashed their June temperature records, but at 11am today both were over 12°C colder than they were 24h ago 🥶

This afternoon is forecast to creep up to 11°C, but clear skies on the longest night will bring a classic midwinter's frosty start tomorrow 🧊

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
